properties.description: Incremental (delta) ingestion pipeline from ADLS Gen2 to ADLS Gen2. Reads all active Incremental Ingress jobs for the given trigger from EDP_Metadata.MasterRef. For file-based sources the watermark is applied as a file modification time filter (modifiedDatetimeStart) on the source read settings — only files modified after Watermark_Value are read. Watermark is only advanced on confirmed successful copy with at least one row transferred. All 9 source/target format combinations (CSV, Parquet, JSON) are covered. Parallel processing via ForEach (batchCount=5). NOTE: source filename in metadata may be a wildcard (e.g. *.csv) to pick up multiple new files per run.

activities.name: Lookup_Metadata
activities.description: Fetches all active Incremental Ingress jobs for the given TriggerName from EDP_Metadata.MasterRef. Returns Watermark_Value (used as modifiedDatetimeStart) and Watermark_Column (label for the tracked time dimension) alongside all connection and path parameters.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT * FROM EDP_Metadata.MasterRef WHERE Trigger_Name = ''', pipeline().parameters.TriggerName, ''' AND IsActive = ''Active'' AND Load_Type = ''Incremental'' AND ActivityType = ''Ingress''')

activities.name: ForEach_Jobs
activities.description: Iterates over all active incremental jobs returned by the metadata lookup and processes them in parallel (batchCount=5).

activities.name: Switch_OutputFormat
activities.description: Routes each job to the correct Copy activity based on SwitchCaseRef. Covers all 9 ADLS format-to-format combinations.

activities.name: Validate_Watermark_CSV_to_CSV
activities.description: Fails fast with WM001 if Watermark_Value is null, preventing an incremental job from running without a valid high-water mark.

message.value: @concat('Incremental job [', item().Metadata_Job, '] (Metadata_ID: ', string(item().Metadata_ID), ') is missing a valid Watermark. Watermark_Column and Watermark_Value must both be set in EDP_Metadata.MetadataRef.')

ifFalseActivities.name: Copy_ADLS_CSV_to_ADLS_CSV
ifFalseActivities.description: Incremental delta: reads only source CSV files modified after Watermark_Value (modifiedDatetimeStart filter). Copies to target ADLS path as CSV.

ifFalseActivities.name: Check_Rows_CSV_to_CSV
ifFalseActivities.description: Skips watermark advance when 0 rows copied (no new files since last run). Watermark preserved so next run re-checks the same window.

ifTrueActivities.name: Update_Watermark_CSV_to_CSV
ifTrueActivities.description: Advances Watermark_Value to current UTC time after confirmed successful copy with rows transferred.

text.value: @concat('UPDATE w SET w.Watermark_Value = CONVERT(DATETIME, ''', formatDateTime(utcNow(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), ''') FROM EDP_Metadata.Watermark w JOIN EDP_Metadata.MetadataRef m ON m.Watermark_ID = w.Watermark_ID WHERE m.Metadata_ID = ', string(item().Metadata_ID))

message.value: @concat('Incremental job [', item().Metadata_Job, '] (Metadata_ID: ', string(item().Metadata_ID), ') is missing a valid Watermark.')
